name: Mbula-Bwazza
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

tone_statements.citation: Van de Velde, Mark (coord.). 2026 [ANR edition 2025]. La structure, l'origine et l'évolution des langues jarawa – JARAWA. Résumé de soumission du projet ANR-25-CE54-1452 (CE54 - Arts, langues, littératures, philosophies; LLACAN, CNRS; déc. 2025 - 60 mois). Paris: Agence Nationale de la Recherche. doi:10.67599/anr-25-ce54-1452.
tone_statements.quote: Nos travaux préliminaires sur la langue mbula ont démontré, par exemple, que ses tons sont inversés par rapport à ceux du proto-bantou, et que la langue a compacté ses structures morphologiques d’une manière qui n’a jamais été attestée dans les 1500 langues Niger-Congo.
tone_statements.translation: Our preliminary work on the Mbula language has shown, for example, that its tones are inverted with respect to those of Proto-Bantu, and that the language has compacted its morphological structures in a way that has never been attested in the 1500 Niger-Congo languages.
tone_statements.locator: anr.fr project page ANR-25-CE54-1452, section 'Résumé de soumission', first paragraph
tone_statements.summary: Tonal; tones show a reversal correspondence with Proto-Bantu (per known 2022 abstract: 2 level tones + downstep).

sources.note: No Mbula publication listed beyond the 2022 Banto1d talk; fieldwork on Mbula 2019; ANR project JARAWA from January 2026 (classification/description of Jarawan).

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2026. The Jarawan Bantu languages in Nigeria; what is new research telling us? Slides, Jos Linguistic Circle (Academia.edu page text via the Internet Archive).

sources.citation: Idiatov, Dmitry & Mark Van de Velde. 2022. A first analysis of Mbula (Jarawan, Nigeria). Abstract, in: Banto1d (First Conference on Bantoid Languages and Linguistics) book of abstracts, Universität Hamburg, Asien-Afrika-Institut, p.13.
sources.note: Nothing on stress; states Mbula has two level tones plus downstep ('Lukas & Gerhardt (1981) transcribe Mbula using three level tones, whereas it only has two, plus downstep').

sources.citation: Van de Velde, Mark & Dmitry Idiatov. 2022. A first analysis of Mbula. Slides presented at Banto1d: First Conference on Bantoid Languages and Linguistics, Hamburg, 23-25 March 2022 (27 slides). [HAL halshs-03847067, file hosted on Idiatov's site]
sources.note: Nothing. Phonology slides (pp.5-12) give vowels, length, consonants, C2 lenition and tone: 'Two tone system; Up to three tones on one syllable; Major tone rules: tone spreading, tonal absorption, LH rising tones tend to be realised as M' (slide 10). No mention of stress/accent/prominence.

sources.note: One substantive sentence - preliminary work on Mbula showed that its tones are inverted with respect to those of Proto-Bantu (i.e. a tone-reversal correspondence PB *H: Mbula L and vice versa); also mentions prenasalised implosives. No inventory given here (the known Banto1d 2022 abstract/slides give two level tones plus downstep).
